description: This file defines the ApAutoConfigurationTask class responsible for handling AP autoconfiguration processes, including message handling, TLV parsing, and configuration management within the beerocks namespace. It includes state management, message handlers, and utility functions related to Wi-Fi and MLD configurations.

classes.name: ApAutoConfigurationTask
classes.description: Class managing Wi-Fi AP autoconfiguration, message handling, and state management.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Main execution method for the autoconfiguration task.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles events triggered during the task lifecycle.

methods.name: fsm_state_to_string
methods.description: Converts task state enum to string representation.

methods.name: handle_agent_ap_mld_configuration_tlv
methods.description: Handles agent AP MLD configuration TLV.

methods.name: find_available_bsta_mld_unit
methods.description: Finds an available BSTA MLD unit ID.

methods.name: handle_ap_autoconfiguration_wsc_vs_extension_tlv
methods.description: Handles vendor extension TLV for WSC.

methods.name: populate_mld_id_in_bss_infos
methods.description: Populates MLD ID in BSS info based on SSID match.

methods.name: configuration_complete_wait_action
methods.description: Waits for AP configuration to complete on a radio interface.

methods.name: send_ap_autoconfiguration_wsc_m1_message
methods.description: Sends WSC M1 message for autoconfiguration.

methods.name: send_enable_disable_endpoint
methods.description: Enables or disables a radio endpoint.

methods.name: handle_bss_reconfiguration
methods.description: Validates and normalizes BSS configuration for a radio.

methods.name: airties_vs_ap_autoconfiguration_wsc_parse_service_status
methods.description: Parses vendor extension for service status.

methods.name: airties_vs_ap_autoconfiguration_wsc_parse_radio_operational_mode_config
methods.description: Parses vendor extension for radio operational mode.

methods.name: find_available_ap_mld_unit
methods.description: Finds an available AP MLD unit ID.
